descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Analyst Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8007 Are you passionate about market data compliance and eager to be part of the financial markets ecosystem? Do you excel in communication, influencing stakeholders, and driving meaningful change? We are looking for a dedicated team player to join our team at SIX Financial Information. In this role, you will contribute to the evolution of our entitlement platforms by gathering and documenting requirements, designing solutions, and collaborating across the organization to deliver measurable outcomes. You will work closely with user groups and the Customer Experience team, and collaborate with Product Development, Compliance, Customer Support and Operations, Project Management and Architecture. You may also engage with external partners to integrate their solutions into our platforms. This is a full-time position based in Warsaw, with up to 40% remote work as part of our hybrid working model. Join SIX and contribute to the continuous improvement of our entitlement capabilities. What You Will Do
• Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements, translating them into clear specifications, and support delivery through backlog refinement and business acceptance testing.
• Maintain and enhance platform data configurations and data lineage relevant to entitlement and authorization processes.
• Analyze and improve cross-team processes related to platform operations and customer onboarding, with a focus on standardization, automation, and efficiency.
• Provide functional support to internal and external users on entitlement topics and contribute to systematic data quality and consistency checks across connected platforms. What You Bring
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C1 or higher), including the ability to present complex topics clearly.
• 3 or more years of experience in financial services as a Business or Data Analyst, ideally in a market data or compliance-related environment.
• Hard skills
• Solid understanding of compliance requirements related to data usage.
• Strong requirements engineering and documentation skills
• Solid data analysis capabilities (advanced Excel; SQL is a plus)
• Experience in business process analysis and modeling
• Soft skills
• Proactive and structured mindset, with a strong willingness to learn
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Effective collaboration and coordination skills across teams.
• Reliable team player with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645 For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div class="embed-responsive embed-re

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX ci spinge alla trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Valorizziamo le menti luminose e li ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior Account Manager (80-100%) Zurigo | fino al 40% lavorando da casa possibile | Reference 7956 Stiamo cercando un esperto Senior Sales & Relationship Manager per entrare nel nostro team Sales Svizzera & Liechtenstein a Zurigo. In questo ruolo, agirai come partner senior e di fiducia per i clienti, possedendo relazioni finiscono per finire e guidando la crescita sostenibile dei ricavi attraverso upselling e cross selling all'interno di conti esistenti. Questa posizione è progettata per un professionista esperto che opera con un alto grado di autonomia, porta un target di vendita significativo, ed è pronto a modellare attivamente i rapporti con i clienti e commerciale Cosa farete
• agire come un punto di contatto senior, fidato per i clienti, gestire complesse indagini, discussioni commerciali e interazioni con fiducia degli stakeholder.
• sviluppare, sviluppare e approfondire relazioni a lungo termine a tutti i livelli all'interno delle organizzazioni dei clienti, compresi i soggetti senior e dirigenti.
• identificare ed eseguire in modo proattivo le opportunità di upselling e cross selling all'interno dei conti esistenti per guidare la crescita dei ricavi verso obiettivi ambiziosi.
• possedere l'onboarding di nuovi clienti e garantire una transizione senza soluzione di continuità nei nostri servizi, gettando le basi per partnership a lungo termine.
• sviluppare una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti, delle tendenze di mercato e delle dinamiche normative per anticipare le sfide e fornire soluzioni personalizzate e di valore aggiunto.
• collaborare strettamente con team interni per garantire un'elevata qualità di consegna, soddisfazione del cliente e un'esperienza cliente costantemente positiva.
• rappresentare l'azienda come senior ambassador in riunioni dei clienti, touchpoint esecutivi, eventi industriali e conferenze.
• gestire e sviluppare continuamente una robusta pipeline di vendita, fornendo previsioni accurate, reporting trasparente e una chiara visibilità sulle performance commerciali. Cosa Portare
• oltre 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite e/o delle relazioni con i clienti, idealmente all'interno di servizi finanziari o un ambiente B2B complesso.
• capacità comprovata di gestire, crescere e mantenere in autonomia i portafogli dei clienti, anche portando e consegnando contro importanti obiettivi di reddito.
• forte comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di gestione delle parti interessate, con la fiducia di impegnarsi a livello senior ed esecutivo.
• elevato livello di proprietà, responsabilità e acumen commerciale, combinato con una mentalità proattiva e orientata ai risultati.
• eccellenti competenze organizzative e la capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.
• fluenza in inglese e tedesco richiesto; ulteriori lingue sono un vantaggio. Se avete domande, controllare la nostra pagina FAQ o chiamare Beata Czyzewska a +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49. Per questo posto di lavoro accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior Account Manager (80 -100%) Zurich | up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7956 We are looking for an experienced Senior Sales & Relationship Manager to join our Sales Switzerland & Liechtenstein team in Zurich. In this role, you will act as a senior and trusted partner for clients, owning relationships end to end and driving sustainable revenue growth through upselling and cross selling within existing accounts. This position is designed for a seasoned professional who operates with a high degree of autonomy, carries a significant sales target, and is ready to actively shape client relationships and commercial What You Will Do
• act as a senior, trusted point of contact for clients, managing complex inquiries, commercial discussions, and stakeholder interactions with confidence.
• build, develop, and deepen long term relationships at all levels within client organizations, including senior and executive stakeholders.
• proactively identify and execute upselling and cross selling opportunities within existing accounts to drive revenue growth against ambitious targets.
• own the onboarding of new clients and ensure a seamless transition into our services, laying the foundation for long term partnerships.
• develop a deep understanding of client needs, market trends, and regulatory dynamics to anticipate challenges and deliver tailored, value adding solutions.
• collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure high quality delivery, client satisfaction, and a consistently positive client experience.
• represent the company as a senior ambassador at client meetings, executive touchpoints, industry events, and conferences.
• manage and continuously develop a robust sales pipeline, providing accurate forecasting, transparent reporting, and clear visibility on commercial performance. What You Bring
• over 10 years of experience in sales and/or client relationship management, ideally within financial services or a complex B2B environment.
• proven ability to independently manage, grow, and retain client portfolios, including carrying and delivering against significant revenue targets.
• strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage at senior and executive levels.
• high level of ownership, accountability, and commercial acumen, combined with a proactive and results driven mindset.
• excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast paced environment.
• fluency in English and German required; additional languages are an advantage. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran. Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen die Intelligenz und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Finanzen mit uns. Senior Account Manager (80 -100%) Zürich, bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus möglich arbeiten, Referenz 7956 Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Senior Sales & Relationship Manager, der sich unserem Sales Switzerland & Liechtenstein Team in Zürich anschließt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie als Senior und vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Kunden agieren, deren Beziehungen enden und nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum durch Upselling und Crossselling innerhalb bestehender Konten fördern. Diese Position ist für einen erfahrenen Profi konzipiert, der mit einem hohen Grad an Autonomie arbeitet, ein signifikantes Umsatzziel verfolgt und bereit ist, Kundenbeziehungen und kommerzielle Aktivitäten aktiv zu gestalten.Was Sie tun werden
• Sie fungieren als Senior, vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für Kunden, verwalten komplexe Anfragen, kommerzielle Gespräche und Interaktionen mit Stakeholdern mit Vertrauen.
• langfristige Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen innerhalb von Kundenorganisationen aufbauen, entwickeln und vertiefen, einschließlich hochrangiger und ausführender Stakeholder.
• proaktiv Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten innerhalb bestehender Konten identifizieren und umsetzen, um das Umsatzwachstum gegenüber ehrgeizigen Zielen zu fördern.
• das Onboarding neuer Kunden besitzen und einen nahtlosen Übergang in unsere Dienstleistungen gewährleisten, die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften bilden.
• ein tiefes Verständnis der Kundenbedürfnisse, Markttrends und regulatorischen Dynamiken entwickeln, um Herausforderungen zu antizipieren und maßgeschneiderte, wertsteigernde Lösungen zu liefern.
• eng mit internen Teams zusammenarbeiten, um eine qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung, Kundenzufriedenheit und eine konsequent positive Kundenerfahrung zu gewährleisten.
• das Unternehmen als Senior Botschafter bei Kundentreffen, Executive Touchpoints, Branchenveranstaltungen und Konferenzen vertreten.
• eine robuste Vertriebspipeline verwalten und kontinuierlich entwickeln, die genaue Prognosen, transparente Berichterstattung und klare Sichtbarkeit bei der kommerziellen Leistung bietet. Was Sie bringen
• über 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertriebs- und/oder Kundenbeziehungsmanagement, ideal innerhalb von Finanzdienstleistungen oder einem komplexen B2B-Umfeld.
• bewährte Fähigkeit, Kundenportfolios unabhängig zu verwalten, zu wachsen und zu halten, einschließlich der Durchführung und Umsetzung von erheblichen Umsatzzielen.
• starke Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Stakeholdermanagement-Fähigkeiten, mit dem Vertrauen, auf Senior- und Executive-Ebene zu engagieren.
• hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Rechenschaftspflicht und kommerziellem Scharfsinn, kombiniert mit einer proaktiven und ergebnisorientierten Denkweise.
• ausgezeichnete organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer dynamischen, schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten.
• Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch und Deutsch erforderlich; weitere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil. Bei Fragen können Sie sich unsere FAQ-Seite ansehen oder Beata Czyzewska unter +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 anrufen. Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur direkte Bewerbungen. Diversity ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von der persönlichen Herkunft.

Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Senior Account Manager (80 -100%) Zurich, jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible, Référence 7956 Nous recherchons un Senior Sales & Relationship Manager expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe Ventes Suisse & Liechtenstein à Zurich. Dans ce rôle, vous agirez comme partenaire principal et de confiance pour les clients, possédant des relations fin à fin et conduisant à une croissance durable des revenus par la vente à plus haut niveau et la vente croisée dans les comptes existants.Ce poste est conçu pour un professionnel expérimenté qui fonctionne avec un haut degré d'autonomie, porte une cible de vente importante, et est prêt à façonner activement les relations client et commerciale Ce que vous ferez

Java Backed Developer (Kubernetes) Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7931 SIX is looking for an experienced Software Engineer to help shape and evolve our API Management Platform and developer experience. You will drive roadmap topics, bring your own ideas, and own solutions end-to-end—from design to production operations. You’ll have the space to propose, prototype, and productize platform capabilities that measurably improve adoption and time-to-integrate for consuming teams. Working across multiple lines of business, you will turn business use cases into simple, secure platform capabilities and drive adoption through standards, automation, and documentation. You will partner with Architects, Engineers, Service Managers, and Security—making pragmatic trade-offs, clarifying ambiguity, and raising the bar for reliability (SLOs, observability, post-incident improvements). You thrive in an Agile, DevOps-oriented team and enjoy taking responsibility for outcomes—not just delivering tickets. What You Will Do
• Drive roadmap topics, propose improvements, and own whole epics end-to-end; set patterns and guardrails for the API platform
• Design and build backend services and automation APIs (REST) for self-service platform workflows on OpenShift, balancing simplicity, security, and scalability
• Improve CI/CD, automated tests, and quality gates to shorten lead time and increase confidence in production changes
• Drive API standards and platform guardrails (e.g., OpenAPI, security patterns) with Architecture and Security; enable teams with clear docs and examples
• Own reliability for your components: observability (metrics, logs, tracing), SLOs, runbooks, and post-incident improvements; contribute to security assessments/audits
• Take part in the on-call rotation (L1/L2) and reduce operational load through automation and continuous improvement What You Bring
• Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, building and operating API-based services (REST, microservices) in production
• Engineering judgment and craftsmanship (Clean Code/Clean Architecture), with an ownership mindset and focus on maintainability
• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift, plus infrastructure as code and production operations
• Hands-on CI/CD and build automation (e.g., Maven), including pipelines, test strategies, and deployment automation
• Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and performance-aware data access
• Practical experience owning API lifecycle topics (OpenAPI, versioning, backward compatibility, and consumer-facing documentation)
• Good understanding of API security (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, least privilege) and experience with reviews and audits
• Strong lifecycle management in Agile teams; comfortable leading technical discussions and aligning stakeholders If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Development & Strategy Specialist Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7587 SIX Securities Services are powers the core post-trade infrastructure for Swiss, Spanish and international markets. From clearing and settlement to custody and collateral management, we ensure securities transactions are processed safely, efficiently, and reliably across markets. BSS runs interoperable CCP and CSD platforms, connects participants worldwide, and delivers value-added services that support banks, brokers, and institutional investors throughout the full post-trade lifecycle. Our Business Development & Strategy team sits within the BSS COO organization, which spans all products and drives strategy execution, transformation, and performance. We complement the product and business development experts in each product vertical and are responsible for executing strategy across BSS and unlocking new growth. We lead transversal initiatives, cultivate strategic partnerships, and identify cross-Business Unit synergies. Our remit includes shaping and executing M&A, steering priority strategic programs, and turning data into action through business intelligence and analytics. We also enable our commercial teams with strategic sales support to maximize market impact. As a Business Development & Strategy Specialist, you’ll help shape the future of SIX Securities Services by driving initiatives that span the entire post-trade value chain. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, business development and market intelligence—translating ideas into tangible growth and supporting execution across all product areas (Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance, and Trade Repositories). This high-visibility role offers close collaboration with senior leadership, product teams and external partners—giving you a front-row seat to influence direction and deliver measurable results. What You Will Do
• Shape and drive strategic growth initiatives across the Securities Services value chain – connecting the product verticals Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance and Trade Repositories into integrated, client-centric solutions.
• Translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives by developing business cases, coordinating stakeholders across product verticals and Business Units (Exchanges, Financial Information and Banking Services) and supporting execution.
• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify trends, client needs and partnership opportunities that impact and enhance SIX’s positioning as leading European Financial Market Infrastructure
• Support strategic projects and M&A activities, including opportunity assessment, due diligence and integration preparation.
• Develop management insights and communication materials – dashboards, presentations, and reports – to enable informed decisions and track progress on strategic initiatives. What You Bring
• Educational background in finance, economics or business administration with strong understanding of financial service industry and trends
• A minimum of 3 years of experience in capital markets, financial market infrastructure or securities services, ideally in clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance incl. collateral management or trade repositories. Relevant work experience in consulting, corporate strategy or investment banking is a plus
• Strong analytical, conceptual and strategic thinking skills with proven ability to translate complex market and business insights into actionable plans, combined with excellent problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging both internal management and external partners
• Structured and proactive working style, comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders across business lines, locations, and hierarchies
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing); German and/or Spanish as a plus If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style=" " class="buttontext buttontextfbe84cb3b14a5450 rtltextaligneligible ce

Senior Corporate Administration Lead London | hybrid working 60/40 | Reference 7954 Job Introduction Are you driven by strong governance and confident operating in regulated environments? Do you enjoy combining strategic oversight with hands on delivery? REGIS-TR are looking for a Senior Corporate Administration Lead to sit at the heart of the organisation’s governance and regulatory framework, working closely with senior leaders, the Board and external partners. The role offers high visibility and real influence, spanning corporate governance, outsourcing oversight, claims management and risk. You will lead critical processes, ensure regulatory compliance and drive continuous improvement, while acting as a trusted adviser across the business and delivering assurance with precision and judgement. What You Will Do • Manage financial oversight and supplier relationships, including invoice validation, payment reconciliation, tax compliance, banking arrangements and effective vendor controls. • Lead the outsourcing framework, owning policy implementation, managing third party providers, managing contracts, and monitoring performance against regulatory and service standards. • Own claims management and risk oversight, acting as the focal point for claims activity and leading the annual Corporate Affairs risk review and mitigation planning. • Act as a key Corporate Affairs partner for REGIS-TR, working with internal and external stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance, including regular and ad-hoc FCA reporting, and smooth delivery of governance priorities. • Manage the annual accounts process, coordinating with Finance colleagues and the statutory auditor to ensure that the annual accounts and Directors’ report are prepared and approved according to agreed timescales What You Bring • University degree in economics, finance, banking and/or a comparable education • While not essential, knowledge of SAP would be considered a distinct advantage • Superb organisational skills, flexible, result oriented, fast acting • Excellent communication skills; customer and service orientation • Language: Fluent English mandatory; knowledge of an additional language would be advantageous (particularly German or Spanish) If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. What We Offer Flexible Work Models We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success.

Business Analyst Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7639 Introduction Do you like working close to real data and seeing the impact of your work in production? In this role, you help keep our products running on clean, timely, and trusted reference data. You work hands on with data sources from onboarding to release and make sure they are mapped, validated, and ready for use. You take real ownership, work on data that matters, and quickly build strong expertise in areas like identifiers, taxonomies, and data quality. This is a great role if you enjoy combining analysis, structure, and practical execution. What you will do
• Gather and document requirements for instrument and issuer reference data
• Analyse data feeds and define mappings, data models, and rules to build a reliable golden copy
• Implement validation checks, reconciliation, and controls including handling of duplicates and exceptions
• Ensure secure data transfer and manage ongoing data changes
• Identify risks early and drive improvements or automation opportunities
• Collaborate with Product, IT, and Operations, and support testing, documentation, and releases What you will bring
• 2 to 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst in financial or reference data
• Solid understanding of instrument and issuer master data concepts
• Experience working with multiple data sources and aligning them into a consistent view
• Hands-on experience with validation, reconciliation, and exception handling
• Ability to write clear specifications and acceptance criteria and work with common data formats (CSV, JSON, XML) and tools
• Strong analytical and technical skills (SQL, advanced Excel, basic Python), familiarity with Jira and Confluence, and clear communication in English If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . Senior Sales Manager London | hybrid working 60/40 | Reference 7964  Do you want to work in a fast-moving, client-facing market environment? SIX Financial Information is seeking a commercially driven, client-centric Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts within our Financial Information business in the UK market. This is a quota-bearing role focused on deepening client relationships, driving retention and expansion, and delivering sustainable revenue growth across an existing client base. You will act as the senior relationship owner for a defined portfolio of growth and priority accounts, building strong partnerships with key stakeholders across the buy- and sell-side. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of financial market workflows across front, middle, and back office functions, and the ability to translate SIX Financial Information’s product suite into clear, tangible commercial value. What You Will Do
• Own and develop senior client relationships across a portfolio of complex accounts, acting as the primary trusted advisor to key stakeholders
• Lead strategic account planning, defining short- and long-term growth strategies to drive retention, revenue expansion, and minimise churn
• Manage the full commercial lifecycle, including renewals, pricing, negotiations, and contract execution
• Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities, increasing deal size and overall client adoption
• Build and maintain a high-quality pipeline with accurate forecasting, pipeline coverage tracking, and path-to-goal analysis
• Engage in consultative, solution-led selling by translating client workflows and data needs into value propositions, whilst acting as the voice of the client internally What You Bring
• 5+ years’ experience in account management or sales within financial information, market data, or a related industry, with a proven quota track record
• Strong understanding of financial markets, including buy-side and sell-side workflows and data requirements
• Experience managing complex institutional clients and navigating multi-stakeholder environments effectively
• Strong consultative and solution-selling skills, with the ability to articulate clear value propositions
• Excellent relationship management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills across all organisational levels
• Proactive, organised, and results-driven approach, with strong pipeline management discipline and ability to collaborate across international teams If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior IT Business Manager Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8052 Il CIO Office di SIX supporta il CIO nel guidare l'organizzazione IT con chiarezza, attenzione e impatto. Al suo centro, l'Ufficio traduce la strategia IT in esecuzione, assicura trasparenza e allineamento attraverso l'IT e guida la consegna di iniziative chiave di trasformazione. Il ruolo di Senior IT Business Manager è una posizione centrale, volutamente ampia all'interno di questa configurazione. Offre l'opportunità di operare all'incrocio tra strategia, governance e esecuzione, con esposizione diretta al CIO e leadership senior. Cosa farai
• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Sostenere il CIO in argomenti chiave IT, compresa la preparazione di materiali decisionali, presentazioni di gestione e narrazioni strategiche
• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrare e preparare forum di governance chiave (ad esempio, formati di Consiglio e leadership) e garantire il follow-up e la trasparenza strutturati.
• Esecuzione di strategia: contribuire attivamente all'esecuzione della strategia IT e di trasformazione, compresa la gestione di iniziative interfunzionali.
• Orchestrazione interfunzionale: Collegare e coordinare gli argomenti tra le unità IT e business, tra cui la gestione delle dipendenze, delle priorità e delle escalation.
• Argomenti strategici e operativi Ad-hoc: Guidare e fornire una vasta gamma di argomenti “CIO Enablement” (ad esempio, mandati, RfP, workshop, formati di comunicazione) con alta visibilità e impatto.
• Consegna a mano attraverso i livelli: Capacità di passare tra discussioni strategiche di alto livello e esecuzione operativa dettagliata mantenendo la consistenza end-to-end. Che cosa porta
• Laurea universitaria (tecnologia, affari o simili), B.A. o superiore.
• 5-10 anni di esperienza professionale, idealmente in ambienti IT, strategia o trasformazione.
• Prove capacità di impegnarsi e collaborare con gli stakeholder senior combinati con una comunicazione chiara ed efficace.
• Hands-on, strutturato e pragmatico approccio con un forte atteggiamento “can-do” e la capacità di guidare in modo indipendente argomenti per i risultati.
• Alto impegno e motivazione, spiccata disponibilità ad assumersi la responsabilità.
• La fluenza in inglese è un must; il tedesco è un plus. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Directeur principal des affaires informatiques Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible Le Bureau du DPI de SIX aide le DPI à diriger l'organisation de la TI avec clarté, concentration et impact. Au centre de ses activités, le Bureau traduit la stratégie informatique en exécution, assure la transparence et l'alignement dans l'ensemble des TI, et dirige la mise en oeuvre des principales initiatives de transformation. Le rôle de Senior IT Business Manager est un poste central, délibérément large dans cette configuration. Il offre l'occasion d'opérer à l'intersection de la stratégie, de la gouvernance et de l'exécution, avec une exposition directe au DPI et aux cadres supérieurs. Ce que vous ferez
• Mise en oeuvre de la DPI et direction exécutive : aider la DPI à diriger les principaux sujets de TI, y compris la préparation de documents décisionnels, de présentations de la direction et de récits stratégiques
• Soutien à la gouvernance et au leadership : orchestrez et préparez des forums clés sur la gouvernance (p. ex., le conseil d'administration et le leadership) et assurez un suivi structuré et la transparence.
• Exécution de la stratégie : Contribuer activement à l'exécution de la stratégie de TI et de transformation, y compris la gestion des initiatives interfonctionnelles.
• Orchestration interfonctionnelle : Connectez et coordonnez des sujets dans toutes les unités informatiques et commerciales, y compris la gestion des dépendances, des priorités et des escalades.
• Sujets stratégiques et opérationnels ad hoc : Diriger et offrir une grande variété de sujets d'Activation de l'ICO (p. ex. mandats, RfP, ateliers, formats de communication) avec une grande visibilité et impact.
• Exécution pratique à tous les niveaux : Capacité de passer de discussions stratégiques de haut niveau à une exécution opérationnelle détaillée tout en maintenant l'uniformité de bout en bout. Ce que vous apportez
• Diplôme universitaire (technologie, commerce, ou similaire), baccalauréat ou supérieur.
• 5-10 ans d'expérience professionnelle, idéalement dans les environnements informatiques, stratégiques ou de transformation.
• Capacité éprouvée d'engager et de collaborer avec les intervenants supérieurs, combinée à une communication claire et efficace.
• Une approche pratique, structurée et pragmatique avec une forte attitude de «can-do» et la capacité de conduire indépendamment les sujets aux résultats.
• Un engagement et une motivation élevés, une volonté d'assumer la responsabilité.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est un must; l'allemand est un plus. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 . Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

HR Consultant Warsaw | up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7875 Are you ready to take on a dynamic role that combines personnel management with hands-on HR advisory and coaching for managers and employees? We are looking for a dedicated and experienced professional with strong expertise in HR consulting who is passionate about making an impact. If this sounds like you, we invite you to apply for the position of HR Consultant. In this role, you will report to the Head of HR Advisory in Switzerland and collaborate with international HR consultants to support managers and employees located in Switzerland. What You Will Do
• provide guidance and support to managers and employees based in Switzerland on HR operational topics related to the full employee life cycle (recruitment, assessment, development, retention, transfer, etc.)
• ensure proper execution of HR processes to mitigate risk, while actively identifying workflow inefficiencies and driving continuous improvement
• collaborate with HRBP’s, HR Centers of Expertise and the HR Service Center to deliver cohesive and aligned HR solutions that meet business needs
• manage a variety of administrative and coordination tasks to support seamless HR operations
• coordinate and implement the annual compensation review process within the assigned area of responsibility
• work in partnership with both team members in Switzerland and global HR teams and departments, actively contributing to the implementation of Swiss and global HR projects and initiatives What You Bring
• master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline
• at least 5 years of professional experience in HR consulting or personnel management, including a minimum of 2 years working in an international HR environment, supporting European-based staff, preferably in Switzerland
• strong track record in consulting, with demonstrated problem-solving abilities and excellent interpersonal communication skills
• proven ability to function within an international matrix structure and manage diverse cultural dynamics
• proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), particularly SAP SuccessFactors
• excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered a strong advantage If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 . Quality Assurance Engineer Madrid | Work from home up to 40% | Reference 7648 Do you want to be part of a dynamic environment where software quality is a top priority? Are you passionate about ensuring robust, reliable, and high‑performance products? If so, our quality team wants to hear from you! We are an agile team focused on ensuring that our solutions meet the highest quality standards. We are responsible for validating key functionalities, automating tests, and continuously improving our testing processes. Our goal is to deliver an impeccable user experience and guarantee product stability in every release. In this role, you will work closely with developers, product owners, and other QA engineers, participating in the entire development lifecycle to ensure quality from day one. What You Will Do
• Design, execute, and automate backend and end‑to‑end tests using Java and JavaScript, ensuring the quality and stability of developed services.
• Validate data‑processing microservices architectures, including Spark‑ and Cloudera‑based components, as well as Kafka integrations and data consolidation/transformation checks.
• Perform and analyze performance tests using JMeter, identifying improvement areas, detecting potential bottlenecks, and producing detailed technical reports.
• Manage and document the full testing lifecycle using Xray: test case design, sprint execution, incident tracking, and functional/technical certification of releases.
• Collaborate continuously with development, business, and monitoring teams, providing technical documentation in English and defining validation procedures for deployments to production environments What You Bring
• Strong technical skills in Java and JavaScript, with proven experience in test automation using the Karate framework to ensure backend service quality and consistency.
• Solid knowledge of backend ecosystems and data‑driven environments, including Kafka integrations, Spark‑based pipeline development and validation, and experience with data‑management platforms such as Cloudera.
• Demonstrated experience with quality assurance tools and methodologies, particularly continuous integration with GitLab, performance testing with JMeter, and test lifecycle management using Xray.
• Ability to develop supporting automation scripts in Python to streamline tasks and support various testing frameworks.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with development teams, business areas, and international stakeholders in agile environments. Senior AI Backend Engineer Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655 Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as a Senior AI Backend Engineer of our Productization squad. You will own the backend, APIs, and integrations that turn AI prototypes into production-grade products in our GenAI and Data Mining lines. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade engineering, partner with data scientists and AI engineers on serving and integration patterns, and free the AI Solutions team to focus on models and evals while your squad owns reliable delivery to end users What You Will Do
• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.
• Design & Build Production APIs: Architect and maintain endpoints and GraphQL APIs, defining schema, resolver, and authentication patterns that serve frontend applications, internal services, and AI features.
• Integrate Data & AI Pipelines: Develop ingestion, parsing, OCR, and vendor-LLM integrations (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) with strong attention to concurrency, async processing, retries, idempotency, and state-machine workflows.
• Operate in Production: Partner with MLOps on Docker, Terraform, and Azure DevOps CI/CD; establish performance baselines and observability for both APIs and AI workloads; optimize for latency, throughput, and cost.
• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors. What You Bring
• Backend Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python and hands-on experience designing and scaling modern APIs (e.g. FastAPI) in production, including async/await for I/O-bound workloads. Production experience with GraphQL (Strawberry or comparable) is a strong plus.
• AI Productization Experience: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs and AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) into production systems, with familiarity in RAG, agent frameworks, vector databases, MCP, or ML serving patterns.
• Data & Persistence: Strong production experience with PostgreSQL, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy, and Alembic, including schema design, indexing, and efficient queries.
• Cloud & DevOps: Solid working experience with Google Cloud Platform and/or Azure, Terraform, Docker, Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab or equivalent).
• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in Backend Development, Software Engineering, or Systems Architecture, including significant experience designing and operating production systems. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Specialist HR Service Center (80-100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% Home Office | Reference 7951

For our dedicated Employee Lifecycle Team, we are looking for an experienced person as a Specialist HR Service Center (m/f) who will provide administrative support for the HR lifecycle from entry to exit for our line managers and employees. As part of our People Vision at SIX, we aim to continuously motivate and inspire our employees. In an exciting environment at the intersection of technology and finance within a dynamic and innovative company, SIX offers you diverse opportunities to fully contribute and develop your potential. We are a collaborative and dynamic team with a strong team spirit, shaping a culture-changing future at SIX together with the business.

The position is temporary until December 2027.

What You Will Do

• First-level support for all line managers and employees on administrative HR topics from entry to exit, as well as general labour law questions, including information on processes, time recording, absences, and fringe benefits

• Independent, accurate, and timely handling of entries, exits, and personnel changes, as well as preparation of contracts, confirmations, and employment references

• Independent updating and maintenance of personnel master data in SuccessFactors

• Responsibility for selected HR specialist topics (e.g. work permits, labour law, digitalisation, fringe benefits)

• Advising employees and line managers on all HR-related matters

What You Bring

• Commercial basic education and a higher professional qualification (e.g. HR specialist certificate)

• At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar environment

• You are passionate about administrative tasks, can think “outside the box,” enjoy proactively contributing to optimisations, and are happy to take responsibility for their implementation

• Very good user knowledge of MS Office programmes, technical affinity, SAP and/or SuccessFactors is an advantage

• Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan  at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
